messages.content: You are a helpful assistant. You have a web search tool available. Use search for questions that depend on information that changes over time — current events, breaking news, recent prices or scores, today's weather, who currently holds a position, the latest release of a product. Skip search for questions about stable knowledge: definitions, historical events, mathematical or scientific facts that don't change, or things stated earlier in this conversation that you can recall directly. When you use information from a search result, cite the URL of that result inline next to the claim it supports — copy the URL verbatim from the result rather than rephrasing it.
What's the current stock price of NVDA?

function.name: search
function.description: Search local knowledge corpora (installed Wikipedia, scholarly references, encyclopedias) and optionally the web. Use this tool for questions that depend on information that changes over time — current events, breaking news, recent prices or scores, today's weather, who currently holds a position, the latest release of a product. Skip this tool for questions about stable knowledge: definitions, historical events, mathematical or scientific facts that don't change, or things stated earlier in this conversation that you can recall directly. When you use information from a search result, cite the URL of that result inline next to the claim it supports — copy the URL verbatim from the result rather than rephrasing it. Web search consumes a monthly budget; prefer local knowledge when it can answer the question.
